subject: Geopolitics
title: Cyber Borders
description: A fast breakdown of Cyber Borders for builders.

hook.text: China's Great Firewall blocks Google, Facebook, and Twitter. 1.4 billion people live in a different internet.

buildup.text: Nations are building digital borders. Russia, Iran, and China each control what their citizens see online.

discovery.text: The splinternet is emerging: separate internets governed by local laws, censorship, and data rules.

twist.text: Even democracies filter content. The EU's GDPR creates a legal border around European data that US firms hit.

climax.text: Cyber borders may matter more than physical ones. Controlling information controls perception itself.

punchline.text: The most powerful borders are the ones you can't see.

quiz.question: What is the splinternet?
options: A faster version of the internet used by governments
Separate internets governed by different national laws and censorship
An encrypted network used only by intelligence agencies
